name: Ultron Half Marathon Powered by CACEIS @ Putrajaya 2026
short_description: The Ultron Half Marathon Powered by CACEIS @ Putrajaya was run on 26 July 2026 from IOI City Mall, Putrajaya, over 5 km, 10 km and 21.1 km.
ai_summary: The Ultron Half Marathon Powered by CACEIS @ Putrajaya took place on 26 July 2026, starting at 3.45am from the West Wing (Old Wing) of IOI City Mall in Putrajaya, Malaysia. The event offered three categories -- a 5 km fun run, a 10 km fun run and a 21.1 km competitive half marathon -- and was listed and managed through the JomRun platform, with entries closing the evening before the race. This edition has been run; the listing is kept as a record of it.

core_facts.venue: West Wing (Old Wing), IOI City Mall, Putrajaya

faqs.question: When was the Ultron Half Marathon Powered by CACEIS @ Putrajaya 2026 held?
faqs.answer: The race was held on Sunday 26 July 2026, with the first wave flagged off at 3.45am from IOI City Mall in Putrajaya. A pre-dawn start is standard for Malaysian road races, which schedule early to get runners off the course before the daytime heat builds.

faqs.question: What distances did the Ultron Half Marathon @ Putrajaya 2026 offer?
faqs.answer: Three categories were offered: a 5 km fun run, a 10 km fun run and a 21.1 km competitive half marathon. The 21.1 km event was the marquee distance, and all three set off from the West Wing of IOI City Mall in Putrajaya.
